rm.quote: Bit 7 ARPE: Auto-reload preload enable 0: TIMx_ARR register is not buffered 1: TIMx_ARR register is buffered
The content of the preload register are transferred into the shadow register permanently or at each update event (UEV), depending on the auto-reload preload enable bit (ARPE) in TIMx_CR1 register.
Setting the UG bit in the TIMx_EGR register (by software or by using the slave mode controller) also generates an update event.
The auto-reload shadow register is updated with the preload value (TIMx_ARR),

stock.quote: autoReloadValue = (uint)val; Enabled = enableRequested && autoReloadValue > 0; if(!autoReloadPreloadEnable.Value) { Limit = autoReloadValue; }

guard.quote: base.WriteDoubleWord(b, b == CcerOffset ? word | AllOutputs : word);

silicon.0: ARPE = 0: 'TIMx_ARR register is not buffered': the preload content is transferred to the shadow register 'permanently', so a new ARR acts at once.
silicon.1: ARPE = 1: 'TIMx_ARR register is buffered': the preload is transferred to the shadow register at each update event, including the one a UG write generates (p1533).

twin.0: Guard forwards the write; stock sets Limit = ARR at the ARR write (L363-368), so a new ARR acts at once.
twin.1: Guard forwards the write; stock leaves Limit at its old value on an ARR write and sets Limit = ARR only in the overflow handler (L62); the UG handler (L265-295) never assigns Limit (grep: Limit is assigned only at L62, L367, L561).

differs: ARPE = 1 only: after ARR is written, silicon loads the new ARR into the shadow register at a UG write (p1533: UG generates an update event that loads the preload), stock does not; stock takes the new ARR only at the next counter overflow. So ARR-write then EGR.UG then CEN gives the new period on silicon and, on stock, the old Limit (0xFFFF at reset, L559-561) for the first period. Also a 1 to 0 write of ARPE does not reload Limit in stock (silicon: the shadow then follows the preload permanently); stock catches up at the next ARR write or overflow. ARPE = 0 matches. Both periods otherwise follow stock's conventions (not read here).
observable_by_firmware: Timing of the first update/PWM period after an ARR change made under ARPE = 1 followed by UG (CNT/UIF/PWM edge timing); TIMx_ARR reads back the preload on both. Whether the flight firmware issues UG after ARR was not examined here.
notes: Guard write path: Write (L130-201) merges the word, RefusedField (L389-415) refuses a word whose field is outside the row's allowed set (not forwarded to stock in enforcing mode; in recorded mode the refusal is logged and the write proceeds, L192-196), then Pass (L255-281) forwards to the stock model. The guard has no ARR/EGR rule in this path (the row ARPE has allowed set Any). arm_values 0x0,0x1 (both written); gen_values 1. The row text names L164 and L365; the preload test is L365 and the field L164. The period convention (stock's Limit ticks vs silicon's ARR+1) is a separate stock convention (guard header L14-17, ruling Q1) and was not read.

silicon.0xc7: PSC = 0xC7 (199): CK_CNT = f_CK_PSC / 200, taken into the active prescaler at the next update event (a UG write is one: p1533).

twin.0xc7: Stock sets Divider = 0xC7 + 1 = 200 on the write; the LimitTimer's frequency becomes Frequency / 200 at once (LimitTimer L211-212), also for the four compare timers (L355). The UG handler does not touch the divider.

differs: Steady-state rate matches for every value (f / (PSC + 1), Divider = PSC + 1 >= 1; 65536 at PSC = 0xFFFF). Timing differs: silicon loads a new PSC at the next update event (a write while running keeps the old ratio until the next overflow/UG, and a write with no following UG leaves the active prescaler at its previous value, 0 at reset), stock applies it on the write itself. Same for any PSC value different from the active one, 0xC7 included.
observable_by_firmware: Counter rate (CNT growth, timing of update/compare events) in the interval between a PSC write and the next update event; none after a UG or an overflow has passed. If the firmware writes PSC, then ARR, then UG, then CEN the twin and silicon agree from CEN on. Whether the flight firmware's sequence includes UG was not examined.
notes: Guard write path: Write (L130-201) merges the word, RefusedField (L389-415) refuses a word whose field is outside the row's allowed set (not forwarded to stock in enforcing mode; in recorded mode the refusal is logged and the write proceeds, L192-196), then Pass (L255-281) forwards to the stock model. arm_values 0xc7 only (gen_values '-'): the formula reading is for every value, the timing difference holds for every value that changes the ratio. The read-back of PSC returns Divider - 1 (L349) i.e. the preload on both. Integer division Frequency / divider in LimitTimer (L211) not examined for rounding.
